summary: Created at the user request while verifying MPI-382. Every masked-edit template feeds the user mask into InpaintCropImproved with mask_fill_holes true and mask_expand_pixels 6 (qwen_edit 243, klein_t2i 276 + 581, boogu_edit 221, krea2_t2i 589), so a mask with a deliberate hole - the Adjust edge band being the case that raised it - is refilled into a solid blob before the sampler sees it, and every mask is grown 6px regardless. needs-decision rather than planned because the user named TWO homes for the control and picked neither: an injected mask_fill_holes toggle, or a Fill button in the Adjust panel. They are not exclusive and only the first unblocks the reported use case. klein_t2i node 286 already runs fill_holes false, so there is a precedent on the same graph to explain or follow.

DECIDED by the user the same day, so needs-decision becomes planned. BOTH halves, not one: fill the holes in the app (a Fill button in the Adjust panel) AND turn mask_fill_holes off in the workflows - the app is where the user can see what he is filling, and the graph must stop making that choice for him. IMPORTANT correction to the card as written: klein_t2i node 286 is NOT an inconsistency to fix. The user wrote that branch and its mask is created INSIDE the workflow, where the fill is intended; only the nodes fed by the USER mask change, which is why the audit names nodes rather than saying every InpaintCropImproved. Acceptance rewritten accordingly, including a new item that the Fill button records an UndoStack entry and is discarded with the rest of the preview. STILL OPEN and deliberately not decided: mask_expand_pixels 6 - the user leans toward removing it now that Adjust lets him add the margin himself and see it, but calls it possibly necessary, so it is settled in planning with the constraint that an Adjust shrink must not be silently undone by the graph.
Workflow half complete - 18 mask-destroying nodes to 0, verified against runtime graphs. App half (Fill Holes button) starting.

Both halves shipped. Workflows: 18 mask-destroying nodes to 0 across 3 mechanisms, verified against runtime graphs. App: Fill Holes in the Adjust panel, two-pass flood so no antialiased seam survives. User verified in the app.
OUTPUT verified by the user: detailing run against a mask with a hole and without one, both behaved. Closes the standing unasked question from two handoffs.
Archived out of board.columns.done to .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/_archived/MPI-431/ (workspace preserved intact). mpi-archive run 2026-08-04.
